cgltf (https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf), MIT (LICENSE).
cgltf.h v1.15 (released 2025-02-09; tag v1.15, commit 360db1a95480fe102ae9c69b27c5d101167ff5ba), unmodified.
Used to read the figure models written as glTF (src/engine/models/figure_gltf.cpp; docs/notes/mods.md, "Models as
glTF"); the writer is ours. cgltf_impl.c is ours: the header's implementation, built as the cgltf library with its
warnings off (CMakeLists.txt).
